original_title: Kickstarter rolls back new mature content guidelines after week of backlash
summary_en: Earlier this month, crowdfunding platform Kickstarter altered its guidelines with regard to adult content. Where before it only prohibited "pornographic" and illegal content, it changed to be more restrictive and almost comically detailed, banning everything from "implied sex acts" to "MILF/DILF" co
